title: Hypothesis
description: A structured security hypothesis formed in the HYPOTHESIZE step of the GRIP loop. Represents a falsifiable claim about a resource's security posture pending verification.

resourceType.description: The cloud resource type under evaluation, in provider-canonical format.

operation.description: The operation type. DETECT evaluates existing resources for misconfigurations. CREATE validates proposed configurations before provisioning. REMEDIATE proposes corrective changes for verified findings.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the specific resource instance. Required for DETECT and REMEDIATE operations. Null for CREATE operations where the resource does not yet exist.

properties.description: Resource properties relevant to this hypothesis. For CREATE, these are the proposed properties. For DETECT, this may be empty (live state is fetched in the GROUND step).

description.description: Human-readable description of the security claim being tested.
